title: Specified constructible Ext bound on an ind-constructible sheaf
statement: Let X be any scheme and let ell be prime. Fix a finite intermediate field E of the p-adic algebraic closure. Let Lambda be the condensed commutative ring object E or Qbar_ell, with its specified multiplication (equality of bundled monoid objects). In Mod(Lambda_X) [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], let C be constant-model constructible [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and let d be a specified natural number such that Ext^r(C,N) is zero for every constructible N and every natural r>d [def-pc-ext]. If B is in the small filtered-colimit closure ObjectProperty.ind.{u+1} of the constructible sheaves, then Ext^r(C,B)=0 for every natural r>d. No Noetherian hypothesis is added. This is only the sheaf input in the one-cohomology case of det-finite-window-bounded.

source.place: vanishing clause; sk-cor-ind-heart-ii.proof.md first two sentences; sk-lem-finite-window-bounded.proof.md one-cohomology case

proof.text: Unpack the ind-property of B to obtain a small filtered category I and a constructible diagram B_i with a specified colimit cocone of vertex B. Regard the diagram as complexes in degree zero, so it has common lower bound zero.

Use clause (1) of the field-coefficient Ext-continuity assertion in the cited blueprint source to identify Ext^r(C,B) with the filtered colimit of Ext^r(C,B_i). Applicability gap retained explicitly: the current Lean declaration and DAG statement [sk-lem-constructible-ext-continuity] impose Noetherian hypotheses absent here. Its unrestricted source formulation, or a proof of the present vanishing conclusion without full continuity, is still needed; the Noetherian declaration is not applied as if it were general.

For r>d the given bound makes each stage group Ext^r(C,B_i) zero. A cocone on zero abelian groups has the zero group as colimit, so the comparison from the previous step transports zero to Ext^r(C,B). In particular this handles B=0, constant presentations and d=0 with the first relevant degree r=1.

proof_origin.place: sheaf-only vanishing argument; explicit record of the source-to-current-Noetherian-formalization applicability gap
